# SignCloud

> API-only cloud build, signing, packaging and cloud-Simulator verification for iOS and macOS.
> A trusted Mac worker compiles with Xcode; clients upload source, poll for a result, and download
> a signed IPA, Simulator app, DMG or verification evidence. Build management is API-only.

Base URL: `https://build.example.com`
Client: `https://build.example.com/client/signcloud_ai.py`
Server: `https://build.example.com`

Every `/v1/*` request sends `Authorization: Bearer $SIGNCLOUD_API_TOKEN`. Read the token from the
caller's environment; never invent one. Public artifact, `/install/{token}` and `/view/{token}`
links need no header.

## Start here

```bash
mkdir -p "$HOME/.signcloud"
curl -fsSL https://build.example.com/client/signcloud_ai.py -o "$HOME/.signcloud/signcloud_ai.py"
chmod +x "$HOME/.signcloud/signcloud_ai.py"
export SIGNCLOUD_SERVER=https://build.example.com
export SIGNCLOUD_API_TOKEN='provided separately'
```

- Signed IPA for a registered iPhone:
  `python3 "$HOME/.signcloud/signcloud_ai.py" . --kind xcode --scheme MyApp --cache-key myapp --name MyApp-iPhone --export-method development`
- Build and drive the app in the cloud Simulator:
  `python3 "$HOME/.signcloud/signcloud_ai.py" . --kind verify --scheme MyApp --verify-script SmokeTests/smoke.yaml`
- Build to the caller's own Simulator: add `--kind simulator --install-simulator`.
- macOS DMG: `--kind macos --scheme App --project App.xcodeproj --signing developer-id --notarize --artifact-format dmg`.
- Re-sign an IPA: `python3 "$HOME/.signcloud/signcloud_ai.py" App.ipa --kind resign`.

The client uploads only changed blobs, waits for the worker, downloads the artifact, and verifies
its SHA-256 when the response provides one.

## Documentation

- [API and builds](https://build.example.com/docs/api.md) — kinds, spec fields, incremental
  upload, poll/list/cancel, response schema, limits.
- [Real iPhone builds](https://build.example.com/docs/ios-device.md) — Apple setup, device
  enrollment, Development vs Ad Hoc, install page, enrollment API.
- [Simulator and verification](https://build.example.com/docs/simulator.md) — local Simulator,
  `verify` flows, live view, evidence ZIP.
- [macOS apps](https://build.example.com/docs/macos.md) — Developer ID, notarization, stages,
  failures, cache correctness.
- [Native libraries](https://build.example.com/docs/native-artifacts.md) — prebuilt static
  libraries, XcodeGen, source archive rules.
- [Service and caching](https://build.example.com/docs/operations.md) — health, cache keys,
  measured timings, limits.

## Non-negotiables

- The worker runs `xcodebuild`, not your build scripts. It never runs `cargo`, `pod install`,
  `npm install`, custom Makefiles or downloaded toolchains. `expo` auto-installs its JS/CocoaPods
  dependencies; `xcodegen generate` is the only other allow-listed action.
- Any static library or vendored framework a target links must be built and included by the
  caller. `ld: library 'foo' not found` means the artifact is missing from the upload.
- Include shared schemes and the generated `.xcodeproj`. Exclude `.git`, `node_modules`,
  `DerivedData`, `build`, `dist`.
- A bundle ID already registered by another Apple team cannot be used. Keep extension IDs
  consistent, prefer automatic signing, remove hard-coded profiles.
- Never enroll devices speculatively; enrollment consumes the team's annual quota.
- Signing secrets never leave the worker: never send `.p8`, certificates, private keys or
  passwords in a prompt or API call.

## Service

`GET /healthz` · `GET /` (discovery) · `GET /llms.txt` (this index) · `GET /docs/{name}.md` ·
`GET /client/signcloud_ai.py`
